title: Contract clause classification (32 clause types)
business_story: Legal-ops and procurement teams review incoming supplier, licence and distribution contracts by tagging each clause with its type so risky terms get routed to a lawyer. Every clause of every contract goes through the classifier, so a cheaper model that tags as well as the top one cuts review cost directly.
instruction:
You are helping a legal team review commercial contracts. Classify the contract clause below into exactly one of these clause types and reply with the label only:
governing_law
anti_assignment
change_of_control
cap_on_liability
uncapped_liability
liquidated_damages
audit_rights
insurance
non_compete
exclusivity
termination_for_convenience
renewal_term
ip_ownership_assignment
right_of_first_refusal
minimum_commitment
revenue_profit_sharing
license_grant
non_transferable_license
irrevocable_or_perpetual_license
affiliate_license_licensee
joint_ip_ownership
source_code_escrow
competitive_restriction_exception
no_solicit_of_employees
non_disparagement
covenant_not_to_sue
most_favored_nation
volume_restriction
warranty_duration
post_termination_services
notice_period_to_terminate_renewal
third_party_beneficiary
attribution: Hendrycks et al., 'CUAD: An Expert-Annotated NLP Dataset for Legal Contract Review', NeurIPS 2021. The Atticus Project.
split_note: inputs are expert-annotated clause spans from CUAD v1 that only one CUAD category covers; split by contract (no contract appears in both train and holdout); stratified across the 32 labels.
